title: AlloyDB Exposes CA & Network Info (Read-Only)
summary: AlloyDB v1beta now exposes cluster Certificate Authority (CA) details and instance network information as read-only properties. Developers should note that several new fields, including CA certificates and instance network details, are now explicitly output-only, which is a breaking change if you were attempting to set them.
details: This update introduces new read-only fields for enhanced visibility into your AlloyDB clusters and instances. The `Cluster` schema now includes `certificateAuthorityInfo`, which contains the `rootCaCert` for client authentication. Similarly, the `Instance` schema gains `networkInfo`, providing output-only details like `publicDnsName` for public connectivity. Additionally, `InstanceNetworkConfig` now supports a configurable `publicDnsEnabled` boolean. Be aware that `rootCaCert` within `CertificateAuthorityInfo`, `certificateAuthorityInfo` on `Cluster`, `networkInfo` on `Instance`, and `publicDnsName` within `InstanceNetworkInfo` have all been explicitly marked as read-only. Any existing code attempting to write to these properties will now encounter errors and must be updated.
